as_told.title: Mellon and Elizondo bring three Navy videos to the Times

plain: This story is about how three military videos of UFOs came to be made public in 2017 through the New York Times. The podcast host Jesse Michels says that Lou Elizondo, a Pentagon official who worked on UFO matters, tried to brief the Secretary of Defense, General Jim Mattis, about UFOs, but was blocked by officials in between. Michels says Elizondo and his friend Christopher Mellon, a former senior Pentagon intelligence official, then went off script and got the Pentagon to clear three UFO videos for release. Michels stresses that putting the videos in a trusted outlet like the New York Times is what made people take notice after decades of silence. A well-known skeptic, Michael Shermer, also brings it up on the same podcast, but frames it as the moment the government said UAPs, its newer word for UFOs, are real, which Elizondo then repeated. It is told because, if the videos show what is claimed, the US military had recorded objects it could not explain.
